description: This file defines command-line interface commands for importing data into Mattermost, including Slack exports and bulk data imports, using the Cobra library for CLI command structure.

methods.name: slackImportCmdF
methods.description: Handles the Slack import command, reading the specified file, performing the import, and logging the audit record.

methods.name: bulkImportCmdF
methods.description: Handles the bulk import command, validating flags, reading the file, performing the import or validation, and logging the audit record.

methods.name: getTeamFromTeamArg
methods.description: Retrieves a team object based on the provided team argument, trying both by name and by ID.
